items.evidence: Log shows 40 uL aspirated from beads A1 and dispensed into each of the 96 wells, followed by 10 aspirate/dispense cycles of 40 uL in the same well. The 5 min incubation comment is recorded before the magnet comment.
The engage-magnet and wait comment is recorded. The log shows 90 uL moved from each of 96 wells to waste, then two rounds of 200 uL ethanol added and 200 uL removed to waste from every well.
Comments record the 5 min air dry, the magnet disengage, the 2 min incubation and the magnet re-engage. The log shows 50 uL water dispensed into each well and mixed 10 times (40 uL cycles).
The log shows 45 uL aspirated from each sample well and dispensed into the same-named elution_plate well (A1 to A1 through H12 to H12).
Every move() call picks up a new tip and drops it (pick up and drop tip pairs in the log) for each well in the supernatant, ethanol, water and elution steps, so there is no cross-contamination.

judge.summary: The protocol performs all pipetting steps correctly, with 40 uL beads and 10x mixing, 90 uL supernatant removal, two 200 uL ethanol washes, 50 uL elution with mixing, and 45 uL transfer to matching elution wells. A fresh tip is used per well and the non-simulated steps are recorded as comments, so all rubric items pass.
